IDT12420.text:

Weather: Partly cloudy.

Seas: Below 1 metre.

Thursday 19 November

Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.

Friday 20 November
Winds: North to northeasterly about 10 knots tending east to northeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then becoming north to northeasterly about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers. The chance of a thunderstorm in the afternoon.

Saturday 21 November
Winds: North to northwesterly below 10 knots tending southerly 10 to 15 knots during the afternoon then becoming variable below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high pressure system centred in The Bight, extends a ridge of high pressure over Tasmania. The high and ridge will move slowly eastwards during the week to be over Tasmania on Wednesday and in the Tasman Sea on Thursday. A low pressure system and associated trough approach from the west on Thursday and is forecast to move over the state on Friday. Another weak ridge is expected to develop over Tasmania on Saturday.
